mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the lettuce wick was most worthwhile: it showed how capillary action can supply moisture while leaving air around the roots.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the hooded lamp felt somewhat uneventful on its own because the result initially gave no explanation.

surprise.text: I was interested that the two beds used different backup approaches: a small pump for the potato trough and a wick for the lettuce.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the purpose of the foil hood became clear after the lamp was mounted.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to learn how the station and its specimens fare after the storm, and the practical survival choices held my interest.
